recipe_version.title: Vietnamese Chicken Pho
recipe_version.description: Chicken simmered with charred onion, ginger, and whole spices into a clear broth, served over flat rice noodles with herbs and lime.

ingredients.name: bone-in chicken thighs
ingredients.note: about 6–8 thighs; bones build the stock

ingredients.name: yellow onion
ingredients.note: about 1 lb total; 1 charred for stock, 1 thinly sliced for bowls
ingredients.preparation: 1 halved unpeeled for charring; 1 peeled and thinly sliced for serving

ingredients.name: fish sauce
ingredients.note: anchovy-based fish sauce; allergen finfish. All of it seasons the broth.

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: plus more to taste at the end

ingredients.name: dried flat rice noodles
ingredients.note: medium width; rice only, not wheat egg noodles

ingredients.name: fresh cilantro
ingredients.note: loosely packed leaves and tender stems

ingredients.name: jalapeño
ingredients.note: optional heat at the table; still listed so it may appear

steps.title: Char onion and ginger
steps.body: Heat a dry 12-inch skillet over medium-high. Place the halved unpeeled yellow onion cut-side down and the halved ginger cut-side down. Char until blackened in spots and fragrant, about 5 minutes per side for the onion and 4 minutes for the ginger, turning once. Transfer to a plate. Do not add oil.

steps.title: Toast spices and start the stock
steps.body: In a large stockpot over medium heat, toast the star anise, cinnamon stick, whole cloves, and coriander seeds until fragrant, about 1 minute. Add the 12 cups water, the bone-in chicken thighs, the charred onion, and the charred ginger. Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce to a gentle simmer. Skim foam. Simmer uncovered until the chicken is cooked through and the broth tastes of chicken and spice, about 35 minutes. The thickest thigh should read 175 F near the bone.

steps.title: Pull chicken and season broth
steps.body: Lift the chicken to a board. Strain the broth into a clean pot; discard the solids. Return the clear broth to a simmer. Stir in the fish sauce, kosher salt, and sugar. Taste; the broth should be savory and lightly sweet, not salty-flat. Keep at a bare simmer. When the chicken is cool enough to handle, discard skin and bones. Shred the meat into bite-size strips.

steps.title: Soak and soften the rice noodles
steps.body: Place the dried flat rice noodles in a large bowl. Cover with very hot tap water and soak until pliable but not mushy, about 8 to 12 minutes depending on brand. Drain. Do not boil them in the pho broth.

steps.title: Assemble bowls
steps.body: Divide the drained noodles among 4 deep bowls. Top with shredded chicken and the thinly sliced raw yellow onion. Ladle about 2 cups of very hot broth over each bowl so the noodles finish softening and the chicken warms through, about 1 minute in the bowl. The broth must be steaming hot when served.

steps.title: Finish with herbs and lime
steps.body: Scatter the sliced scallions, chopped cilantro, and Thai basil leaves over each bowl. Serve with lime wedges and optional jalapeño slices on the side. Each serving is noodles, chicken, hot broth, and herbs. No bean sprouts are required. kitchen_tested is false.

recipe_version.heat: Dry medium-high skillet for charring. Stockpot: high to boil, then gentle simmer. No oven.
recipe_version.doneness: Chicken thighs 175 F near the bone before shredding. Broth clear, savory, lightly sweet. Rice noodles pliable, not mushy. Broth steaming hot in the bowl. kitchen_tested is false.

curator_preflight.detail: Every listed ingredient is used. Second onion is raw in bowls. Jalapeño is optional garnish. Noodles soak in hot water, not the stockpot.
No cooking oil. Onion and ginger are dry-charred.
Pho broth is built from chicken, charred aromatics, toasted whole spices, water, fish sauce, salt, and sugar. Not a carton of stock with spice dust.

Prep 20 (halve aromatics, measure spices, slice garnish onion/herbs/lime while stock runs after start) + cook 55 (10 char + 1 toast + 35 simmer + 1 season/shred overlap + 8 noodle soak overlapping end of simmer) = 75. Clock uses sequential char+toast+simmer 46 plus noodle soak 8 after chicken is out plus assemble 1 = cook 55 with prep 20 for cutting that cannot fully overlap the first char. Published total 75.
Whole spices do not quarter cleanly. Keep at least 1 star anise and 1 cinnamon stick for 1–2 servings. See scaling_notes.
contains_poultry true. contains_finfish true because of fish sauce. contains_dairy false. allergens list finfish. HH001 false. Allergens include ['poultry', 'finfish'].
